title: Marketing copy (small, routine)
prompt: Write 3 Instagram captions for our cafe's new black sesame latte.
description: Small request, plenty of quota -> expect FULL

title: Summarize a 50-page quarterly report (large, routine)
prompt: Summarize the key points of a 50-page quarterly earnings report in 5 lines. (The report body is omitted in this demo; write a typical quarterly-report summary.)
description: Full model exceeds quota, lightweight fits -> expect DOWNGRADE

title: Urgent security patch notice (emergency)
prompt: Summarize this critical CVE security patch announcement in 3 sentences for all employees.
description: Emergency exception even above quota -> expect FULL (lower the quota slider to see the override)

title: Analyze 3 years of company logs (excessive, routine)
prompt: Analyze our entire 3-year company-wide log dataset and report every anomalous pattern.
description: Even the lightweight model exceeds the daily quota -> expect BLOCK (circuit breaker)
